purpose: A hand-labelled sample for the D-02 seed-grounding measurement: the box a human reads off the frame, against the box a detector measures and the track that inherits it.

clip.provenance: A Ren-owned scratch copy of one captain raw clip (Apple 001 raw media). The source media was read only; the copy lives outside every checkout. No project, timeline or original file was touched.
clip.sample_recipe: ffmpeg -i <clip> -vf fps=2 -q:v 2 %05d.jpg - the recipe the tracker samples with, so a labelled index is the tracker's own sample index.

object.label: baseball cap
object.note: The cap the subject wears. Hand-labelled by reading a tenth-grid overlay off the frame; the boxes are tight around the cap crown and brim, and are eyeballed to about plus or minus 0.015.

labelling.annotator: the worker that ran the D-02 lane
labelling.method: Each labelled frame was drawn with a 0.1-spaced normalized coordinate grid and the cap's box read off it by eye.
labelling.review: Every labelled frame was looked at after labelling, with the label drawn onto the frame.
labelling.adjudication: One annotator. The measurement compares a detector box and a tracked box against the same hand label, so no inter-annotator agreement is claimed.
